paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 57a disparagingly, and he was one of the High Priests in the Second Temple period; see there.[^1]

notes.text: מכה״ג is read as “one of the High Priests,” preserving the מ prefix; ע״ש means “see there.” נז. gives Pesachim 57a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. The disparaging mention and Second Temple high-priest classification remain Hyman’s assertions, not fresh historical findings.
